title.zh: 【币安将上线美国银行、盈透证券等 4 只股票永续合约】
title.en: 【币安将上线美国银行、盈透证券等 4 只股票永续合约】

current_state.zh: Binance will roll out USDT-margined, 24/7 perpetual contracts on four US stocks — Constellation Energy, Bank of America, Interactive Brokers and Medtronic — with up to 20x leverage starting 17:00 on October 21.
current_state.en: Binance will roll out USDT-margined, 24/7 perpetual contracts on four US stocks — Constellation Energy, Bank of America, Interactive Brokers and Medtronic — with up to 20x leverage starting 17:00 on October 21.
